# SurfaceOne for React — component catalogue

Install: `npm install @surface-one/react @surface-one/tokens`. Every component is exported from `@surface-one/react`; its props are the Angular inputs of the same family (see the docs page for the API).

## Layout

Structure a screen: sidebars, cards and dividers.

### Sidebar

A collapsible application sidebar with header, groups, menus, badges, a rail and an inset content area — shadcn/ui Sidebar for Angular.

- Import: `import { SoneSidebar, SoneSidebarContent, SoneSidebarFooter, SoneSidebarGroup, SoneSidebarGroupLabel, SoneSidebarHeader, SoneSidebarInset, SoneSidebarMenu, SoneSidebarMenuBadge, SoneSidebarMenuButton, SoneSidebarMenuItem, SoneSidebarRail, SoneSidebarTrigger, SoneSidebarWrapper } from "@surface-one/react";`
- Docs: https://monoone.dev/surface-one/components/sidebar/

### Card

A surface that groups related content, with header, title, description, action, content and footer parts.

- Import: `import { SoneCard, SoneCardAction, SoneCardContent, SoneCardDescription, SoneCardFooter, SoneCardHeader, SoneCardTitle } from "@surface-one/react";`
- Docs: https://monoone.dev/surface-one/components/card/

### Separator

A one-pixel hairline between content, horizontal or vertical, decorative or semantic.

- Import: `import { SoneSeparator } from "@surface-one/react";`
- Docs: https://monoone.dev/surface-one/components/separator/

### Collapsible

Show and hide a region with a trigger that keeps aria-expanded and aria-controls in sync.

- Import: `import { SoneCollapsible, SoneCollapsibleContent, SoneCollapsibleIcon, SoneCollapsibleTrigger } from "@surface-one/react";`
- Docs: https://monoone.dev/surface-one/components/collapsible/

### Collapsible Section

A titled section that folds: a header button with a chevron, subtitle and count, and the content below.

- Import: `import { SoneCollapsibleSection } from "@surface-one/react";`
- Docs: https://monoone.dev/surface-one/components/collapsible-section/

### Section Heading

The heading row of a section: a real h2 to h4 named by its title alone (an optional count is read after it), with actions at the end.

- Import: `import { SoneSectionHeading } from "@surface-one/react";`
- Docs: https://monoone.dev/surface-one/components/section-heading/

### Disclosure

A progressive-disclosure section following the WAI-ARIA Disclosure pattern.

- Import: `import { SoneDisclosure } from "@surface-one/react";`
- Docs: https://monoone.dev/surface-one/components/disclosure/

### Accordion

Stacked sections that show and hide their content, one or several at a time, following the WAI-ARIA Accordion pattern.

- Import: `import { SoneAccordion, SoneAccordionContent, SoneAccordionItem, SoneAccordionTrigger, AccordionValue } from "@surface-one/react";`
- Docs: https://monoone.dev/surface-one/components/accordion/

## Element

The small building blocks: buttons, badges, alerts and indicators.

A user image with initials fallback and a generic glyph when signed out.

## Form

Inputs, selects, switches, sliders and choice controls.

Fields, labels, descriptions, errors and input groups with addons — native inputs styled by the system.

A native select as a form control with projected options.

The native checkbox with an indeterminate state, paired with its label through a field, for forms and select-all lists.

- Docs: https://monoone.dev/surface-one/components/checkbox/

A set of native radios sharing one name and one value, with arrow keys and a single Tab stop, as a form control.

- Import: `import { SoneRadio, SoneRadioGroup } from "@surface-one/react";`

An on/off switch that works as a form control, in two sizes.

A search box with a search glyph, a clear button, Enter to submit and Escape to clear, as a form control.

## AI Chat

Threads, messages, bubbles and status markers for assistants.

### Terminal

An agent conversation as a terminal: a monospace log where your lines stand out, quiet tool activity, a live status that says who is working and for how long, and a prompt.

- Import: `import { SoneTerminal, SoneTerminalDivider, SoneTerminalLine, SoneTerminalLog, SoneTerminalPrompt, SoneTerminalPromptInput, SoneTerminalStatus, AgentState } from "@surface-one/react";`

### Agent Chat

The same agent conversation as a chat: your messages in accent bubbles, agents under their avatars, quiet tool activity, a live working status and a composer. Swaps with Terminal part for part.
